info.timeAllocation:
Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 100-minute final exam + 103.25 hours self-study
1 session = 45 minutes
info.description:
This course is designed to help students further improve their ability to communicate in English in a wide range of business and business-related situations. It also helps students develop the necessary knowledge and skills to succeed in business. In addition to the business-focused contents, the course is enhanced with supplementary activities corresponding to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. In particular, the course will help students:
* communicate effectively in discussions, meetings, negotiations, socialization events
* acquire and effectively use professional skills including telephoning, presentations, correspondence exchange, decision-making, and problem-solving.
* enrich knowledge of business trends in the fast-changing world
*apply AI tools effectively and ethically to support business communication, research, language enhancement, and workplace tasks.
* enhance students' employability
info.studentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Use AI tools effectively and responsibly
- Access the course website (https://fu-edunext.fpt.edu.vn/) for group discussions to construct knowledge, for practicing and assessment

clos.loDetails: Demonstrate knowledge of business vocabulary, terminology and concepts in digital business, finance, management, and operations to convey messages clearly and effectively. Apply AI tools in understanding and applying the vocabulary, terminology and concepts in different contexts.

Demonstrate the ability to effectively and ethically apply AI tools to support communication, research, and problem-solving tasks in Business English, enhancing language proficiency, professional presentation skills, and workplace readiness.

Build awareness and understanding of business situations, including how to communicate in different business contexts and working across cultures with authentic content from the Financial Times and other news sources. Apply AI to analyze business situations and communication contexts.

Apply the principles of effective business communication, including clarity, conciseness, and formality; Demonstrate a professional attitude in all forms of business communication, showing respect, politeness, and consideration for others.

Apply language skills, soft skills and business skills to work and communicate effectively in various international business settings. Apply AI in generating, giving feedback to build the language skills.
Demonstrate critical thinking skills to analyze business problems and scenarios critically.
Write e-mails, cover letters, memo, proposal and brief reports and other creative commercials. Apply AI in generating examples; analyzing effective language use and purposes.
Be cooperative, supportive, and responsible in group work.

Apply the processes involved in job hunting, including writing resumes and cover letters, preparing for interviews, and networking that enhances employability. Applying AI in generating materials and feedback for authentic scenarios.

Identify key points, main ideas, and specific details in business news reports and conversations, recognize different communication styles used in business settings and distinguish between different speakers and identify their roles in a conversation. Apply AI tools in planning ideas; implementing roadmap and strategies for projects; and use AI effectively as a tool to practise skills.

assessments.questionType:
Groupwork and role play: Form groups and perform a role-play simulating a typical day in an international business office.
• Each student takes on a role (e.g., manager, client, team member, HR officer).
• Engage in tasks such as conducting meetings, negotiating, handling conflicts, and giving presentations.
• A 10-minute recorded video of the role-play.
• A reflection report (300–500 words) explaining the communication strategies used and their relevance.
• Suggested AI Tools:
• ChatGPT for script drafting and scenario brainstorming.
• Speechling or Elsa Speak for pronunciation and fluency practice.
• Canva for Education for visual aids in presentations.
assessments.knowledgeSkill: Knowledge and skills in studied unit(s): Unit 6

assessments.questionType:
Pair-work:
• Work in pairs to create and deliver a pitch for a fictional startup or product.
• Include business idea, market analysis, financial overview, and a call to action.
• Deliver the pitch live or as a recorded presentation.
• A 5-minute live or recorded pitch presentation.
• A written pitch deck (slides or document).
• A short Q&A session with peers acting as investors.
• Suggested AI Tools:
• Grammarly for polishing written content.
• Beautiful.ai for creating pitch decks.
• Lumen5 or Synthesia for video presentation enhancement.
• LinkedIn Learning for pitch and presentation skills.

assessments.gradingGuide:
Students are tested individually
1. Students randomly draw a problem-solving scenario to be solved.
2. They have 2 minutes to think about the situation or problem and formulate a solution.
3. Students then discuss their solution for 3-5 minutes.
4. The teacher follows up with 2-3 additional questions related to the given scenario for 2-3 minutes
Topics for discussion are the topics covered during the course
